in_marathi.name: Madhavrao
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Madhavrao हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Madhav means 'God of Love' and Rao is a title of respect for a ruler. So, Madhavrao means 'God of Love, Respected Ruler'.

in_bengali.name: Madhavrao
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Love
in_bengali.long_meaning: Madhavrao একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Madhav means 'God of Love' and Rao is a title of respect for a ruler. So, Madhavrao means 'God of Love, Respected Ruler'.
